summary: The engine, the bindings and every Rust crate compiled into the GDExtension get an admission record: content/art/third_party_ledger.json carries name, pinned version, SPDX id, canonical URL and the verbatim notice text read from the crate's own licence file (or noticeText null with needsReview when no licence file exists in this environment); the validator holds the ledger equal to godot-rust/Cargo.lock in both directions; the credits page carries the notices and the shell suite holds the page equal to the ledger.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at 04bdd7a. P11 is re-theming the shell in shell_style.gd, so this lane adds no colour or font code to credits.gd -- only new blocks built from the ShellStyle helpers that already exist. No Rust, no world/board/battle/ui script, no other content file touched. The card named tools/verify-godot.sh as the engine's version pin; it is not -- that script takes whatever GODOT or PATH gives it and pins nothing. The pin lives in .github/workflows/verify.yml (GODOT_VERSION 4.7.2-stable with its SHA-512) and the templates' in nightly.yml, so those are the files the records name and the validator checks exist. The card also expected the engine and the bindings to be credited with their notices; neither notice text can be read from any file in this environment -- the crates publish none and the pinned engine zip holds only the executable -- so both stand as noticeText null with needsReview true, which is the case the card itself provisions for. Getting those eight notices is the follow-up work, and STILL_OWED on the page says so.
